content:
Leah: Noticed an unexpected binding on `jobs-prod-key` giving `group:legacy-svc-admins` roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter. kicking off a cleanup. tagging infra + sec.
Marcus: Any failed decrypts or customer impact?
Leah: No customer impact flagged. Audit log shows repeated decrypt calls from an ephemeral test runner in us-central1 at 2026-03-20T22:17Z. sample entry below.
Leah: ```json
{"ts":"2026-03-20T22:17:09Z","actor":"svc-runner-ephemeral@redwood-ci.iam.gserviceaccount.com","action":"crypto.decrypt","key":"projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/jobs/cryptoKeys/jobs-prod-key"}
```
Evan: Who owns `legacy-svc-admins`? ownerless groups are high risk.
Leah: SCIM shows no owner. I propose: 1) create least-priv custom role `roles/redwood.kmsJobsDecrypt` with only `cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.useToDecrypt`, 2) identify sps using the group and migrate them to per-svc bindings, 3) remove group binding.
Marcus: Sounds good. Can we do a staged rollout? migrate a small percentage and run smoke decrypts?
Leah: Yes. Plan: create role, bind to `svc-jobs-canary`, run decrypt smoke at 5% of callers, increase to 25% after 1 hour, then full cutover. mark original binding as "suspended" in access tracker so SRE doesn't touch it.
ops-runbook-bot: Runbook page: https://playbooks.internal/redwood/access-ops#kms-cleanup 
Follow section "suspend-binding-and-canary".
Marcus: What CLI for emergency removal if something breaks?
Leah: Emergency remove: 
```bash
gcloud kms keys remove-iam-policy-binding jobs-prod-key \
  --location=global --keyring=jobs \
  --member="group:legacy-svc-admins@redwood.com" \
  --role="roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter"
```
Leah: Safer path: 
```bash
# create custom role
cat > kms-jobs-role.yaml <<EOF
title: "redwood KMS Jobs Decrypt"
stage: GA
includedPermissions:
- cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.useToDecrypt
EOF
# then create and bind to specific service accounts
redwood-adminctl apply-role --file=kms-jobs-role.yaml --name=roles/redwood.kmsJobsDecrypt
redwood-adminctl bind --role=roles/redwood.kmsJobsDecrypt --principal=serviceAccount:svc-jobs-canary@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com --resource=projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/jobs/cryptoKeys/jobs-prod-key
```
sec-bot: Alert: 3 anomalous bindings found across keyring `jobs`. Created ticket SEC-4399 assigned to Leah.
Marcus: Add this to the quarterly least-privilege audit spreadsheet and note ownerless group. link: https://docs.internal/compliance/least-priv-2026Q1
Evan: When we remove old binding we need to capture evidence for auditors: export IAM diff, audit logs slice, canary decrypt success logs, and upload as an "evidence bundle" to compliance (see https://compliance.internal/evidence-uploader).
Leah: Agreed. I'll own the ticket. tentative removal window: 2026-03-23 02:00 UTC after canary validation. will paste smoke test output here. :white_check_mark:
Marcus: Thanks. also please add a note to the incident channel if removal is forced during business hours.
Leah: will do. updating SEC-4399 with migration steps and trace IDs now.
